testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/checkout/validate-user-can-place-order-with-cod-payment-method-guest-user.spec.ts > Webstore - Checkout > validate user can place order with cod payment method (guest user)

scenario.summary: Guest adds a grouped product (quantity 2) to the cart, checks out as guest with a typed address, picks Custom Flat Rate shipping and pays with Charge on Delivery (COD); the order is placed and the receipt thank-you banner is checked.
steps: Open the webstore as a guest (empty storageState).
Search the grouped product SKU, open its result, set the group quantity to 2, add to cart and view the cart.
Checkout as guest ('Proceed to Checkout') and fill the guest shipping address.
Select Ship Complete and Custom Flat Rate shipping.
Remove the auto-applied voucher if its number matches voucherCode, then select COD.
Place the order and check the 'Thank You For Your Purchase' receipt banner.
stateChanges: Guest cart filled with the grouped product
A new guest order is placed (Charge on Delivery (COD))
assertions: Receipt banner visible and equals thankYouMessage ('Thank You For Your Purchase').
evidence: Title 'validate user can place order with cod payment method (guest user)' matches the flow: grouped product, guest checkout, Charge on Delivery (COD) payment, order placed.
groupProduct z-2200003 is searched, opened (page object clicks [id='0-<sku>']) and its group quantity set to 2: PRODUCT_GROUPED_IN_STOCK, quantityUsed 2, no add-ons or personalization selected.

checkoutPage.selectShippingMethod clicks Ship Complete and then lblShippingMethodFLAT (Custom Flat Rate): SHIPPING_FLAT_RATE_ON_STORE with shippingCode FLAT. Destination country assumed 'us' (the address is masked or is the account's default address); assumption.
Guest address fields (address.*) are typed by the test into its own guest order: created-by-test, kept masked; not records.
Store MaxwellsHardware: the store every migrated webstore spec runs on (same as the approved shopping-cart and PDP entries); not named in the scan.
Profile (atstage 2026-10-31) has no observations for this spec: every source is profiled false.
checkoutPage.selectCOD clicks the COD radio: PAYMENT_COD_ON_STORE.

voucherCode 'GDVDM6P78H' is passed to removeVoucherIfPresent: the test removes an auto-applied voucher only when its number equals this value. It is a defensive clean-up setting (config), not a record the test needs; no vocabulary key covers vouchers. If another voucher is auto-applied it stays on the order.

swap: data only through loadData (groupProduct -> product.sku), no derived assertions (receipt texts are fixed UI text), no data value in the spec code (z-2200003 only in the JSON), no other data file.
